name: kss-ui
description: KSS in Claude Code: a live board pane, a progress band above the prompt, the grill queue, and a per-phase read guard. Reads .kss/current and the feature README; owns no state of its own.

guard.title: KSS read guard
guard.description: phase-files: deny reading the phase files a phase must not read. strict: also deny source files outside the KSS and docs folders. off: no guard.
